function.name: measure_distance_for_tunisia_api
function.description:
This is the subfunction for tool "tunisia_api", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "This endpoint calculates the distance between two locations based on their latitude and longitude coordinates, while allowing the user to specify the unit of measurement.

Below Example: **Distance from Sfax to Tunis**"

unit.description: Unit of distance measurement, valid options are **km** (default), **mi**, **ft**, and **yd**.

function.name: reverse_geocode_for_tunisia_api
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "tunisia_api", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "This endpoint allows you to perform reverse geocoding in Tunisia by providing query parameters for latitude and longitude. It returns the name of the city where the location is located."

function.name: facilities_lookup_for_tunisia_api
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "tunisia_api", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "This endpoint allows you to get facilities in Tunisia like hospital, bank, college, etc. by providing optional query parameters for facility type, province and city. It returns a list of facilities that match the query parameters."

city.description: The city where the facility is located

province.description: The region where the facility is located

type.description:
The type of amenity facility to search for (default: **hospital**)
Options:
**aerodrome, bar, cafe, fast_food, pub, restaurant, college, driving_school, school, university, bank, atm, pharmacy,** etc..        

[More options->](https://wiki.openstreetmap.o

limit.description: The number of facilities to query.

function.name: geocode_for_tunisia_api
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "tunisia_api", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "This endpoint allows you to lookup locations in Tunisia by providing an address query parameter. It returns the latitude, longitude and city name of the location."

address.description: The name of the location to look up.
